{{Top|leg}}
A '''Thaereian Stock Certificate''' was a type of investment. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rast'tul]] held some Thaereian Stock Certificates within a lockbox inside his [[Rast'tul's house|house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]]. However, in about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the box and the certificates within it were stolen by the child [[Night Forael Wren|Night Wren]] and the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
